threadDescriptions.poetry-batch: Catalogue the donated small-press poetry pamphlets as individual stock.
threadDescriptions.school-bundle: Assemble and dispatch an affordable poetry bundle to Elm School.
threadDescriptions.return-claims: Resolve the unrelated return of a defective chess manual.
threadDescriptions.window-display: Build the autumn window display using borrowed props.
threadDescriptions.till-rolls: Replenish receipt paper of the correct width.

items.text: Donation from the old print co-op: nineteen poetry pamphlets. Give each its own record, even where the covers look identical.
items.rationale: Starts individual cataloguing of donated poetry.

items.text: Window plan: a paper moon over three orange crates. Borrow the moon from Suri; she needs it back before the parade.
items.rationale: Specifies the shop window installation.

items.text: Elm School wants twelve poetry books under £60 including postage. Teacher asked for short poems suitable for reading aloud.
items.rationale: Defines school poetry order.

items.text: Receipt roll core reads 12 mm; paper width looks like 57. Measure it before ordering another carton.
items.rationale: Identifies receipt-paper procurement.

items.text: Chess manual return, order 57: pages 81–96 duplicated, 97–112 absent. Customer sent these photos and wants a replacement.
items.rationale: Defective chess-book return uses order number 57.

items.text: Pamphlet checklist: Noon Ferry has eight leaves, not missing pages. Its foldout cover makes it look incomplete. Record the artist's initials exactly as printed.
items.rationale: Clarifies physical description for one donated pamphlet.

items.text: Elm shortlist has eleven titles. Add Noon Ferry only if the price still leaves six pounds for postage.
items.rationale: Selects titles against school order budget.

items.text: Moon will fit in the window if the middle orange crate goes sideways. No books against the glass: condensation yesterday.
items.rationale: Tests window-display arrangement.

items.text: 57 again. too wide? ring after 2
items.rationale: Could refer to paper width or order number; insufficient evidence.

items.text: Replacement chess manual checked page by page; complete. Email the prepaid return label for the defective one.
items.rationale: Advances replacement of the defective manual.

items.text: Count correction for print co-op intake: eighteen pamphlets, not nineteen. Two rubber bands held one long foldout together; it wasn't a second title.
items.rationale: Corrects original donation count.

items.text: Actual till paper is 58 mm wide, 12 mm core. Previous 57 was an estimate from the squashed roll. Order two boxes of the measured size.
items.rationale: Corrects receipt-paper measurement and orders stock.

items.text: School packing list and stock update: reserve Noon Ferry and eleven other pamphlets for Elm, total £51. Mark those twelve catalogue records sold as a bundle and print the itemized enclosure for their librarian.
items.rationale: Updates stock records and creates the school's shipment enclosure.

items.text: Rename the 'Autumn crates' window job to 'Paper Moon'. Same borrowed moon, same orange crates; use the new heading on Suri's return reminder.
items.rationale: Explicit rename of the window job.

items.text: Supplier confirms 58 mm till rolls arrive Friday. Keep the current roll's cardboard core as the size sample.
items.rationale: Confirms paper order.

items.text: Elm's poetry carton collected. Librarian approved the itemized £51 list; postage was £5.40.
items.rationale: Records collection and cost for the school shipment.

items.text: Chess customer chose a refund after all. Stop the replacement before dispatch; refund order 57 when the faulty copy comes back.
items.rationale: Revises resolution of the chess return.

items.text: Co-op pamphlet records left to finish: title lettering on Salt Steps and the unnumbered white booklet. Use first lines when no title exists.
items.rationale: Remaining cataloguing work in the donated batch.

items.text: Paper Moon lit from the left now. Suri's name is on the reverse of the prop so it won't be sold with the stock.
items.rationale: Documents finished display and prop ownership.

items.text: No label on this envelope. 'Hold the white one' written across flap.
items.rationale: Colour reference cannot resolve the intended object or thread.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: 57 is ambiguous between roll width and a return order, so keep this source uncertain.
